Materials and Methods

The selected method used a YMC-Pack ODS-AQ (150 x 4.6 mm, 3 um) column.

Eluent A: water with 0.1% formic acid. Eluent B: acetonitrile.

The flow rate was 1.0 mL/min and the column temperature was 30 C.

The selected method run time was 12 min.

Results

Under the selected method, compound 4a had a retention time of 7.4 min.

The 4a peak remained symmetric at 7.4 min.

Desired isomer showed a retention time of 7.4 min.

The main peak had a retention time of 7.4 min.

Target compound showed a retention time of 7.4 min.

PMP glucose peak had a retention time of 16.7 min.

PMP-glucose peak showed a retention time of 16.7 min.
